description: Rail deflection measurements on an operational mainline with asphalt-concrete trackbed layer is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Martin Lidmila. In 2016 a trial section was created on an operational mainline railway track. The trackbed in the section incorporated an asphalt-concrete trackbed layer with 70% of recycled asphalt concrete in the mixture. The purpose of the measurement presented in this dataset was to analyse the behaviour of the section before and after the construction. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is restricted according to the metadata; the conditions were not read. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (Embargo: 2020-04-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
